items.summary: My Perfect Boyfriend Was Actually a Tyrannical Emperor? In a romance novel where a war-obsessed tyrant falls in love with a sun-like saintly heroine, Carolina is reincarnated as an extra with absolutely no connection to the original plot. For Lina, an ordinary working girl who cares more about whether she has to work late tomorrow than about the romance of the century, her mundane daily life is turned upside down when, one day, a boyfriend with dazzling good looks appears as if by fate... ...I had no idea back then. “...Lina. Are you planning to eat the emperor and run?” That the cutest, most lovable boyfriend in the world was actually the Emperor! A secret romance born of a misunderstanding, Lina’s heartbreaking efforts to protect her boyfriend from the cruel Emperor (?)! A sweet yet dangerous romance inside the imperial palace between a clueless girl and a straight-talking Emperor! (Source: KakaoPage, translated)

items.title: Blossoms of the White Night
alt_titles: บุปผาใต้คืนตะวันฉาย
items.time_updated: อัปเดตเมื่อ 4mos ago
items.summary: To secure an alliance between the northern kingdom of Leracal and the southern realm of Arnata, the countries’ royal families agree to a political marriage. Tei, known across the frozen battlefields as the most fearsome warrior and monster hunter, volunteers himself as the kingdom’s hostage, trading his life as a warrior for that of a bride. In Arnata, Tei finds not the hostility he anticipated but the calm, steady gaze of Shuraka, the young crown prince destined to become both his spouse and future Padisha of the empire. For Shuraka to claim the throne, however, he must survive an uprising that threatens the kingdom - once that forces him to draw the blood of his own brothers. Moved by the courage and gentle integrity of his betrothed, Tei pledges to protect him at any cost…and in the quiet hours of a white night, two hearts caught between loyalty and longing begin to bloom.

items.summary: "Six months... Just six months, and it'll all be over." After a one-night stand Hollywood with top star Chase Miller, Joshua finds out he’s pregnant. As a single father, Joshua raises their child in secrecy. But when he is forced to return to work as Chase’s bodyguard, the two are reunited in a cruel twist of fate. Relieved that Chase doesn’t seem to remember him, Josh’s comfort is short lived - something primal, something desperate, yearns for the touch of his former lover, and every time he sees this beautifully twisted man, Josh’s heart races in spite of his mind. The more time passes, the more boundaries blur as instinct takes over… Will Joshua be able to resist the lips of his former lover? Or are the strings of fate too strong to resist? (Source: Lezhin)

Since I’ve come back to life, there’s nothing I can do. To avoid repeating the foolish past, I used that enemy-like guy as my wallet. “Give me everything from here to there.” “You’re going to buy all of this?” “Well, I heard from my friends that my dear granddaughter likes shopping so much, and that you act cute, too.” “It’s just because I need a wallet. Even the once-broken family relationship was splendidly restored. The business of love, which I had once already given up on, had also started perfectly. It was the perfect future I had hoped for… even to someone like me who thought I was incompetent, power awakened within me.

items.summary: Every night, he prayed to wake in a world of magic and adventure. One day, his wish came true, though not in the way he expected. He awoke in a vast, snowy wilderness as a Barbarian, a powerful race feared for their strength and savagery. Though the world was everything he’d dreamed of, his new form came with challenges. Determined not to live as a mindless brute, he learned the human tongue, studied their customs, and became a registered mercenary. But despite his efforts to belong, his monstrous appearance and overwhelming strength lead most to see him as a threat. Now, caught between the world he longed for and the one that rejects him, he must fight to prove he’s more than what others fear and uncover the reason he was brought here in the first place.

items.summary: After killing his brother, Clois ascends to the throne. His desire to become emperor was not for personal gain but for the sake of his beloved wife and soon-to-be-born child. However, upon his return, the corpses of his wife and child greeted him, demonstrating the futility of his efforts. Seven years later, he couldn’t find joy in anything in the world. So, he didn’t care about the re-opening of the gifted academy’s admissions after seven years. Until he saw a wrinkled application form rolling on the floor. Instead of trying to enroll the child in the gifted academy, he offered various excuses. The document, thrown away like trash without even being considered due to being from a workhouse. “I approve this child’s admission.” He wasn’t particularly interested. It was just a warning to those who tried to act arbitrarily. So he couldn’t even remember the name of the child he picked. “My name is Ivy Alden.” The child he met in front of his wife’s and daughter’s graves resembled the daughter he had always imagined.

items.title: Things That Deserve to Die
items.time_updated: อัปเดตเมื่อ 1mo ago
items.summary: Contract killer Lee Jagyeong’s gun never misses, piercing the heart with flawless precision. It does not matter how bad the target is. He takes the job, kills the mark, gets paid, and that is the end of it. The only things he believes in are his own skills and money. Then one day, a sudden high paying request comes in from a regular client. Five million dollars, with a single condition: Kill Kang Ilhyeon and retrieve one item from his safe. The target is the son of Korea’s crime syndicate kingpin. Kang Ilhyeon is a man with sharp, serpentine eyes. Standing inside a trap Ilhyeon has laid out, Jagyeong finds himself slowly being cornered, the noose tightening around his neck. “I heard a very interesting story while I was on a business trip to Hong Kong.” “……” “Aren’t you curious what that interesting story is?” “Someone’s trying to kill me. In my own house, no less.” “Explain it. I’ll decide whether to believe you after I hear it.” Will Jagyeong succeed in killing Kang Ilhyeon and completing the job, or will he meet a pointless death himself? A battle between men who would not be surprising to see dead at any moment has begun. ---

items.time_updated: อัปเดตเมื่อ 1mo ago
items.summary: How far would you be willing to go to save the ones you love? With his grandfather bordering life and death, Taesun takes on multiple jobs in order to pay a seemingly endless stack of hospital bills. On one of his odd jobs, he ascends the great mountain Geumryang, unknowingly the home of an eponymous serpentine spirit. When Taesun encounters the divine being, he too is on the brink of death, desperate for water in his slithering form. Taesun offers him a sip of water, and saves the sacred snake from certain death. Later that night, a cold-blooded body embraces Taesun and offers him an exchange: bear the ancient being’s seed, and his grandfather will live. But is all really as it seems? After all, can one ever truly trust the forked tongue of a serpent…? Original Webtoon

items.summary: Ludbekia was forced into a political marriage with Arenphrit, the escort knight she had a crush on since childhood. However, married life was not as smooth as she expected, so Ludbekia prepared a love potion as her last hope. “Are, are you asking for a divorce?” “It means we should return to our original places. It was a marriage neither of us wanted.” But before she could administer the potion, her husband's divorce notice arrived. To make matters worse, Aren noticed she had put something in his drink, and the misunderstanding grew to an irreversible extent. At the moment when everything seemed to fall apart, Ludbekia drank the beverage containing the love potion instead of her husband— That night, the couple, who were on the verge of divorce, ended up sharing an unexpected night together. A relationship that began in a marriage that should have ended. Where will the marriage of these two people, who like each other but have constantly been at odds, truly lead?

items.summary: The cherished youngest daughter of the prestigious Jujak clan, Jeok Soya, is suddenly exposed as a fake. “Strip her of her spirit core and lock her in the Cold Palace.” Though her heart ached from her family’s cruelty and cold rejection, she endured it. After all, she was just a wicked little fledgling who had deceived them and brought them sorrow. “Please… get rid of that child.” But even so, accepting death was a different matter entirely. “What is this… little fluff ball?” At the brink of danger, the one who saves Soya is a ferocious tiger— No… the head of the Baekho clan. “I think I’ll steal you, little fluff.” Accepting his suspicious offer, Soya follows him to the land of Baekho. She plans to live quietly, never drawing attention… but something about this clan is strange. “Don’t worry, you’re no trouble at all. Stay here as long as you like.” The clan head, infamous for his brutality, is unexpectedly gentle. “Try calling me ‘Oppa,’ Soya.” “Me too! I’m your oppa now, fluff ball!” The young masters of the Baekho clan compete to become her older brothers. And strangest of all— “Our little fluff lady is just too adorable!” “Hmph! Bet your old house didn’t have a fluff this cute, huh?” “…Me? Cute? Not useless and dreadful?”

items.summary: I was forced to live in captivity for the rest of my life because I happened to be aware of the fact that I was a saint. I was truly a 'real' saint, but that didn’t matter, because there was already a designated saint in the temple. When I died from all the abuse I endured, I was sent back to a time before all those previous events in my life had happened. After fifteen regressions, I was exhausted. I prayed, "I don't want anything to do with this, so please just let me die." And at the moment when I thought could finally be able to die, someone said, "How about being my daughter?" …That monstrous grand duke adopted me. --- "I want to quit. I don't want to live being exploited again." Despite having the powers of a saint, she had to live her entire life in captivity—all for the sake of the fake saint who was anointed in secret. Unable to endure the torture any longer, she died alone and returned back in time. Daina, who chose a different path at the end of her forced repeated regressions, was adopted by the Grand Duke in a twist of fate… "As the sole daughter of the Teresia family, I will make it so that you have everything." Now that she has a new name and understands the importance of family, Daina decides to exact revenge so she can no longer be used by the temple. ---

items.summary: Orphaned at a young age, Layla Llewellyn feels like the luckiest girl in the world after she moves in with her uncle Bill, a gardener who lives on the scenic Arvis estate in the Berg Empire. To Layla, Arvis seems like paradise; she loves to explore the vast forest, always bringing her notebook to record the wildlife she encounters. She especially loves the birds, watching them with awe as they hatch and grow from fluffy chicks into beautiful birds. Duke Herhardt, the young, handsome lord of Arvis, is also interested in birds-and in Layla. But the difference is, he’s interested in birds because he likes to hunt them… and he’s interested in Layla because he likes to make her cry. If a lovely bird is trapped in a golden cage, which will she choose: a life of luxury, or freedom? (Source: kaiscans.com)

Though it is said that Mugo handpicks his sacrifices no one in the head family believes such an old tale anymore. However, Jaheon knows that Lord Mugo came to him when he was a child and picked him to be the sacrifice, and even remembers the events of the day. Even though Jaheon has prepared himself, both body and mind, for as long as he could remember, upon entering Mugo's lair he quickly realizes that he doesn't want to be eaten as a sacrifice, at least not after finding out the "Lord Mugo" he adored was just one of the snake god's three personalities. Will the Snake God take pity on his sacrifice? Or will Jaheon be swallowed whole? --- Original Webtoon

items.summary: Jo Yeon-oh is an extreme dominant alpha, heir to the Haeseong Foundation and CEO of Naban Gallery. By his side since childhood is beta So Gi-hyeon, who has quietly watched over him for years while nurturing his love alone. What once seemed like an unbreakable relationship begins to crack the moment Gi-hyeon confesses. The instant Gi-hyeon reveals the long held feelings in his heart, Yeon-oh responds with a humiliating dry heave. “You forgot that you’re a beta.” An alpha who feels a visceral disgust toward dating a beta. Faced with such cruel, bone deep rejection, Gi-hyeon tries to quietly bury his feelings, but Yeon-oh refuses even that. Driven by selfish obsession and a need for control over what he considers his, Jo Yeon-oh will not allow Gi-hyeon to leave his side. “Fine. Let’s date. You selfish bastard.” Instead of cutting ties, what begins is a deceitful relationship. Yet because it is Yeon-oh’s choice, Gi-hyeon accepts it without protest. “If you really can’t stand it, I said I’d help you find someone. Stick to omegas if you can.” Even while they are dating, Yeon-oh coldly suggests that Gi-hyeon sleep with others, a twisted form of consideration that steadily carves wounds into Gi-hyeon’s heart. Eventually, Gi-hyeon reaches his limit. And at the end of his long, desperate unrequited love, Gi-hyeon is confronted with a physical change he believed could never happen. Jo Yeon-oh, a man armored in warped possessiveness and denial of his own attraction, and So Gi-hyeon, who silently swallowed his wounds until he finally chose to run. Where will the misaligned paths of these two ultimately lead? ---

items.summary: I learned far too early in life that things rarely go as planned. “Here, hold your twentieth younger sibling.” Lurubel Derams is the eldest daughter of the squirrel family, renowned for their loving and harmonious household. She has more younger siblings than links in a string of sausages, a father who works himself to the bone as a butler, and a mother who can barely manage to put work aside despite her frail health. But even when life lets her down, the eldest daughter of the Derams family still heads to work today. “You’ve heard the rumors, haven’t you? They say Duke Kun Russell Blantiger was granted his title because his eldest brother died on the battlefield. I heard he later adopted his only nephew. That must be why he’s looking for a tutor.” Duke Kun Russell Blantiger. The man known as the King of the North. He was an aristocrat among aristocrats, wielding the formidable power of a grand ducal house. “Oh, but how could an inadequate teacher like me possibly work in such a strict household?” If she carelessly stepped into a place like that, she might never make it out in one piece. She needed to be cautious. “They say the salary is fifty gold coins.” “Where do I need to go?” “Have you ever considered getting married?” “I have absolutely no intention of getting married. I want to keep working at Blan Castle for a very, very long time!!” “Then how about getting engaged to me?” Pardon? What did I just hear?

items.title: Cyberpunk Chivalry

items.summary: Having finally carved a bloody path of vengeance to its bitter end, the legendary swordsman known as the Bloodline of Kunlun closed his eyes, ready for eternal rest. Instead, he opens them to the hum of neon and the stench of decay. He hasn’t returned to the earth; he has awakened centuries later in the scrap yards of a sprawling futuristic metropolis, resurrected inside a cobbled-together humanoid body built from salvaged metal: Ash . Gone is his flesh and blood. Gone are his dantian and the deep reservoir of internal Qi that once shook the murim. In a world ruled by advanced cybernetic weaponry, high-tech mega-corporations, and cold steel, he is nothing more than a discarded machine. Until he tries to throw a punch. With no internal energy left to channel, the electric currents humming through his mechanical chassis suddenly spark, answering to the ancient katas etched into his soul. Electricity replaces Qi. The old martial arts still work. “I want revenge.”

items.summary: High school student Hitori "Bocchi" Gotou has no social life or any friends—unless you count her guitar. She dreams of creating a school band in the hopes that using her instrument will elevate her social standing. However, despite spending the last two years diligently practicing guitar, she is no closer to her goal. Although she has gained a following online for her guitar covers of popular songs, Bocchi's lack of social skills means that her dream may ultimately be impossible. But one day, drummer Nijika Ijichi spots Bocchi with her guitar alone in a park. Desperately in need of a guitarist, Nijika quickly recruits Bocchi to the band that Nijika has formed with bassist Ryou Yamada—Kessoku Band. Though overwhelmed and left floundering at the sudden social interaction, Bocchi realizes this may be the start of something bigger.

items.summary: In a time and place where one's soul can be morphed into a weapon, there are modern-day magicians called Mage-Knights. Although Kurogane Ikki is a student at an institution that trains Mage-Knights, he has no particular talent in magic and is labeled the "Failure Knight" or "Worst One." Getting way less than average marks in the scorings, he was forced to repeat a year. But with the arrival of a new head of the institution, a new rule was created: knights whose abilities are compatible, as decided by the board, must share rooms and attend practice and training together throughout their school years to bring up their abilities to the max. It is a rule to implement the absolute verdict of ability. Ikki's roommate, Stella Vermillion, turns out to be a princess of another foreign country. Stella is a Rank A knight: the type of genius in magic who only appears once a decade. When Ikki walked in on her while she was changing her clothes, it caused a huge misunderstanding, which eventually ended up in a duel between the two of them. The punishment for the losing side is Eternal Submission to the winning side. Forced to live the same room and practice magic together throughout all their school years, how will Stella and Ikki's relationship evolve?

items.summary: A college debate was supposed to end with a winner. Instead, Charlie died. He awakens in Liangjing, a world where cultivators shatter mountains, powerful sects compete for supremacy, and strength speaks louder than words. Armed with his memories and a mysterious ability called Logos, Charlie must learn to survive battles that no argument can win. Alongside Mei, a fierce twin-blade swordswoman; Jin, a dependable spear fighter; and Su Lian, an aspiring combat mage, he enters dangerous trials, confronts powerful rivals, and uncovers secrets reaching far beyond the imperial capital. In a world where the strong determine the rules, Charlie must forge his own Dao.

items.title: Kuzu no Tadashii Aishi Kata
items.time_updated: อัปเดตเมื่อ 1yr ago
items.summary: Remi doesn't know what love feels like. In the summer two years after she gets her first full-time job, she bumps into Hodaka Arishima, a guy she was friends with benefits with back in school. Even though he was a playboy, he was also popular. For some reason, they had great chemistry. More than anything, he was a jerk who knew every inch of her body. After one particular incident, though, they stopped all contact with each other. Hodaka reassured her that she wasn't special to him, and since he smiled when he said it, Remi now thinks they can become friends again. That assumption changes when this older Hodaka declares that he won't wait for her any longer. He'll make her feel so good that she'll cry in pleasure? and this time, they'll finally share real love and real lovemaking.

items.summary: Soa, the daughter of a wealthy merchant, believed she had married happily to the nobleman Arek. But their marriage fell apart, and four years later he hands her a divorce. As she tries desperately to cling to him, Soa dies in an accident—or so it should have been. When she wakes, time has rewound to the very day Arek proposed, the peak of her life. To avoid an unhappy marriage this time, Soa rejects the engagement, declaring, "I will not marry you!" She expects the cold Arek to back down at once, but instead he pursues her with a passion utterly unlike before, as if he has become a different person. To make him despise her, Soa pretends to be a wanton villainess—yet he only answers, "I will grant whatever you desire, so will you give yourself to me alone?" His unreserved, heated caresses leave her soaked to her core, and even as she tries to refuse, her body accepts his shape on its own. Still, to make Arek happy, she is determined to avoid this marriage this time. A tale of mutual pining and doting love that begins with a do-over.

items.summary: "I'll grant you one wish every time I drink your blood." Those were the words of Xeno, a terrifying vampire who threatened the entire kingdom. Despite being born into a prestigious noble family, Fiora has dedicated her life to serving as the commander of the knights. However, due to her stepsister's schemes and a royal decree, she is offered up as a bride to the vampire. Her mission has only one objective: gain his trust, wait for an opening, and take his head. But when Fiora finally comes face-to-face with Xeno at their sacrificial wedding ceremony, she discovers a threat far more terrifying than she could have imagined. He has no need for a bride and seems intent on destroying everything in his path. Yet the moment he tastes Fiora's blood, his demeanor changes completely. For some inexplicable reason, he develops an obsessive fixation on her alone, demanding a "reward" every time he drinks her blood—!? He's the very enemy she's supposed to eliminate. Refusing him could cost her life, but getting close to him brings an unexpected sweetness. A romantic fantasy filled with deadly mind games, dangerous temptation, and unexpected love—all beginning with a marriage to a vampire!

items.summary: There is no 'later.' Our Season is Now! A sweet and salty everyday comedy cooking manga about a two-woman family. Various forms of families exist around us. However, the lives of families not bound by blood or marriage often go unnoticed. How do those who do not fit into "normal" families manage to live? The comic Our Season is Now sheds light on the lives of a two-woman family by utilizing the theme of seasonal food. Our Season is Now is the personal story of author SUMMUNG, who lives by cooking and eating delicious meals with her partner, Manto, despite being constantly pressured by weekly deadlines. Because she has formed a family that receives neither the recognition of her original family nor the protection of laws and institutions, feelings of skepticism—such as "When is it my season?"—emerge easily. However, the attitude of author SUMMUNG, who devotes herself to daily life to make 'today' her season, appeals to sincere empathy for everyone seeking to reflect on the preciousness of everyday life.
